main_text.p: dari curavi,ubi ne verbulo qvidem ipsum appetii; in eas tamen insurgit famam-qve meam dilacerat. Tacitus hæc & le-go & ab aliis audio & tacere semper de-creveram, qvanqvam scribendi materi-am & insultandi campum qværens, mi-hi varia imponeret; Abruperunt tan-dem silentium meum, horrenda qvædam opinionum monstra, qvorum me accu-sarunt homines duo,in me præfationem-qve meam sordidissimarum injuriarum plaustra debacchati; Flores enim, qvi-bus caput meum coronant, sunt ejusmo-di; me vocant belluam insanam, rabie percitam, monstrum, qvod Judæi qvo-qve execrantur, hominem infinitæ sto-liditatis, desperatissimæ vecordiæ & ple-raqve alia non dissimilia; Cum igitur his hominibus, licet in eorum libro nul-lum extaret eruditionis specimen, re-spondere decrevissem, de censore meo aliqvid obiter perstringere necessarium judicavi, ne de simili materia scribens, qvæ mihi imposuerat, admittere viderer.
Hæc paucis, mi Buxtorfiut[?] scias qvo-ties,

page.notes: Line 25 "Buxtorfiut": the word space between "Buxtorfi" and "ut" is unclear in the scan, so it is marked [?]. The first word of the page is a continuation from the previous page. Some letters in the upper right area are faded but were readable. No catchword or signature is printed. The ink smudge near "fordidissimarum" and the scan edge at the right do not affect the text.
